entities.name: Germán Gullón
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Germán Gullón was a Spanish literary critic and writer who was a professor of Spanish literature and member of the Amsterdam School for Cultural Analysis at the University of Amsterdam. He authored, besides his scholarly works and essays, two books of short stories, Adiós, Helena de Troya and Azulete, and two novels, Querida hija and La codicia de Guillermo de Orange.
